description: Defines the Store class for distributed key-value storage with timeout management, including methods for set, get, compareSet, delete, wait, multiGet, multiSet, and queue operations, as well as a RAII guard class for timeout handling.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Abstract class representing a distributed key-value store with timeout and extended API support.

classes.name: StoreTimeoutGuard
classes.description: RAII guard class to temporarily set and restore the store's timeout.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe copy of the store.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store.

methods.name: compareSet
methods.description: Atomically compares and sets a key's value.

methods.name: get_to_str
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key as a string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value to a key (e.g., increment).

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks existence of multiple keys.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns the number of keys in the store.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for keys to be available.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current store timeout.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the store timeout.

methods.name: watchKey
methods.description: Deprecated method for watching a key.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to a key.

methods.name: multiGet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple keys at once.

methods.name: multiSet
methods.description: Sets multiple key-value pairs.

methods.name: hasExtendedApi
methods.description: Checks if extended API features are supported.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Pushes data to a queue (not implemented).

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Pops data from a queue (not implemented).

methods.name: queueLen
methods.description: Returns queue length (not implemented).

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys (not implemented).
